text:
jane (Auditor): Hi team — can you provide evidence for the emergency RBAC change on 2026-03-01? Auditor needs: who approved the change, the approval artifact, linked KMS key rotation logs, and the incident playbook run notes. Need minimal export (no PII) by EOD if possible.

anna (Security): Thanks @jane. We have an approval thread and a signed change ticket in our tracker. I can pull the RBAC delta and approver info. Do you want the raw diff or a summarized CSV?

jane (Auditor): Summarized CSV is fine. Include username, role_before, role_after, approver, and ticket id. Also need traceable KMS operations for the same window (key-use & rotate events).

mike (Infra): I can export KMS audit events from CloudTrail for that window. Will filter by key ids referenced in the ticket. Prep note: we retain CloudTrail logs for 1 year in s3://redwood-audit-logs. Exports are presigned links.

sam (Eng): FYI we also have an automated rollback flag triggered by the deploy bot — saved in the deploy logs. Might be relevant to incident timeline. I can add the deploy log snippet.

lisa (Compliance): Heads-up: redact any customer identifiers before export. Compliance policy: remove user email domains and token hashes. Also keep a manifest of redactions.

oncall-bot: Incident runbook "rbac-emergency-rotate" executed by @anna at 2026-03-01T15:42Z — runbook entry: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rbac-emergency-rotate (log id: run-8321)

anna (Security): Quick plan: 1) RBAC delta CSV (sam helps) 2) CloudTrail KMS events JSON (mike) 3) Deploy log snippet + rollback flags (sam) 4) Redaction manifest (lisa) 5) One-page timeline and approver tickets (me). ETA 6 hours?

jane (Auditor): 6 hours works. Also: can you include evidence that the KMS key rotation followed our key policy (rotation schedule + KMS CMK alias mapping)? We need key metadata and who performed the rotate API call.

mike (Infra): Will include CloudTrail events with API names: ScheduleKeyRotation, RotateKey, ReEncrypt, Encrypt, Decrypt. I'll attach the key metadata JSON (alias, creationDate, rotationEnabled).

sam (Eng): For RBAC delta CSV: using our internal script:

```bash
# export roles diff between snapshots
roles-diff --from snapshot-2026-02-28 --to snapshot-2026-03-02 --out rbac-delta.csv
```

sam (Eng): I'll run that and strip email domains per lisa's redaction guidance.

lisa (Compliance): For redaction manifest, follow this minimal format: field,path,redaction_reason. Example: email,user.attributes.email,remove domain. Keep manifest as CSV.

jane (Auditor): Also need a link to the incident ticket and a short note from the oncall explaining why emergency change was required (1-2 sentences).

anna (Security): Incident ticket: CHG-9876. Summary: urgent privilege escalation vulnerability in token service; mitigation required immediate role restriction for the service account. I'll add a 2-sentence justification in the timeline doc.

mike (Infra): Preparing CloudTrail query; will run a scoped extract. Query example (Splunk-like):

```splunk
index=cloudtrail "ScheduleKeyRotation" OR "RotateKey" OR "Decrypt" earliest=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z latest=2026-03-02T00:00:00Z
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters.kmsKeyId awsRegion requestID
```

mike (Infra): Export path: s3://redwood-audit-logs/exports/CHG-9876/2026-03-01-kms-events.json (presigned for 7 days). I will share the presigned link after sanitization.

anna (Security): Sam, can you add the deploy artifact hashes and the rollback flag lines? We want traceability from change request -> deploy -> any rollbacks.

sam (Eng): Yep. I'll include deploy id deploy-4458 and snippet:

```
deploy-4458 | user: buildbot | action: apply-iam-delta | rollback: false | timestamp: 2026-03-01T15:40:12Z
```

sam (Eng): There's also a rollback check later at 2026-03-01T16:20Z but it was not executed (flag remained false). I'll include that event.

jane (Auditor): Good. For the KMS items, auditor wants proof-of-possession for who called the API: show ARN + requestID + timestamp. That suffices.

lisa (Compliance): Reminder: provide chain-of-custody manifest listing each file we export, who prepared it, and their signature (email/name). We'll sign with our compliance mailbox.

anna (Security): I'll assemble package: rbacs.csv, kms-events.json, deploy-log-snippets.txt, timeline.pdf, redaction-manifest.csv, chain-of-custody.csv. Will upload to secure share and DM presigned link.

mike (Infra): Ran the initial extract; counts: 12 KMS-related events in the 24h window. Most are Encrypt/Decrypt from the token service, 2 were RotateKey entries by service account arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/kms-maintainer.

sam (Eng): RBAC delta produced 7 changes, 2 service accounts had role tightened. CSV ready, redacted, uploading to the export folder now.

anna (Security): Upload complete. Files: s3://redwood-audit-logs/exports/CHG-9876/rbac-delta.csv (redacted), kms-events.json, deploy-snippets.txt, timeline.pdf, redaction-manifest.csv, custody.csv

jane (Auditor): Received presigned links, starting review. Quick q: can you confirm log retention policy applied to those CloudTrail buckets at time of change? Need retention policy version and any lifecycle rules.

mike (Infra): Retention policy: object lock disabled; lifecycle rule to transition to Glacier after 90 days; bucket versioning enabled; policy version v2 deployed 2025-11-10. I'll attach the bucket policy snapshot.

lisa (Compliance): Also confirming no PII present in the exported files. I spot-checked rbac-delta.csv and kms-events.json — sanitized.

jane (Auditor): Thanks all. If I find gaps I'll list follow-ups. For now this satisfies the sample request. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

anna (Security): Thanks team. Filing a short retro to capture whether we can automate this export for future audits.

jane (Auditor): One follow-up: can you add a small note that vulnerability triage ticket links to CHG-9876? If yes, mark this thread resolved.

anna (Security): Done — vuln ticket VULN-2042 linked. Closing this evidence request.
